summary.headline: 6 risks checked, 4 potential gaps: 2 had no policy wording found, 1 appears excluded, 1 needs checking, 1 is covered with conditions and 1 is covered.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Equipment breakdown
findings.explanation: This is a relevant risk for a bakery. Why it matters: Production depends on ovens and mixers; a breakdown stops baking. No policy wording about this risk was found in the documents analysed, so this is a potential gap. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker about equipment or machinery breakdown cover, because no policy wording for this risk was found.

findings.title: Excluded: Flood, storm and water damage
findings.explanation: The policy appears to exclude this risk (Section 2 - General Exclusions, page 5 of policy P001). A claim for this kind of loss may be refused, so this is a potential gap. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker whether property and contents cover can be added as an extension or a separate policy.

evidence.excerpt: This policy does not cover loss or damage caused by flood, inundation, storm surge or the overflow of any river, canal or drain, unless an extension for flood is shown in the schedule.

findings.title: Potential coverage gap: Payment fraud and chargebacks
findings.explanation: This is a relevant risk for a bakery. Why it matters: The business accepts card payments, which can be targeted by fraud. No policy wording about this risk was found in the documents analysed, so this is a potential gap. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Ask your broker about cyber and payment fraud cover, because no policy wording for this risk was found.

findings.title: Needs checking: Forced closure after premises damage
findings.explanation: The policy mentions loss of gross profit if stated in the schedule, but the schedule was not provided. This creates an unclear coverage status.
findings.recommendation: Request the schedule to confirm if the business interruption extension for premises closure is included.

evidence.excerpt: Where stated in the schedule, the insurer may consider loss of gross profit following interruption of the business at the premises. The indemnity period and sum insured for this extension are as shown in the schedule.

findings.title: Covered with conditions: Theft, burglary and vandalism
findings.explanation: The policy appears to cover this risk only if certain conditions are met (Section 3 - Burglary, page 7 of policy P001). Condition noted: Theft is covered only when it follows forcible and violent entry into the premises. Check this with your insurer or broker before making decisions.
findings.recommendation: Check that you can meet the policy conditions for this risk, and ask your broker about property and contents cover if you cannot.

evidence.excerpt: The insurer will indemnify the insured for loss of contents by theft only where the theft follows forcible and violent entry into or exit from the premises. Theft without signs of forcible entry is subject to the conditions stated in the schedule.

findings.risk_name: Fire from cooking and baking equipment
findings.title: Covered: Fire from cooking and baking equipment
findings.explanation: The policy covers fire damage from cooking or baking equipment used at the premises. This includes gas ovens and fryers, which are common in bakeries. Your business is protected against fire-related losses from these sources.
findings.recommendation: Verify with your insurer that your cooking equipment is specifically listed in the policy schedule for full coverage.

evidence.excerpt: The insurer will indemnify the insured against physical loss of or damage to the property described in the schedule caused by fire, including fire arising from cooking or baking equipment used at the premises.

disclaimer: This report is decision support only. It is based on the policy text that was analysed and identifies potential coverage gaps; it is not a legal or binding coverage decision. Confirm every finding with your insurer or insurance broker.
warnings: Some findings use standard wording because the AI wording did not pass the safety checks.
